name: Independent Civilian Camp and Administrative Support

facts.credit_banks: sparse per occupation and competency; baseline capability already includes prior history, so no duplicate starting credit is stored
facts.monthly_rule: settle every crossed calendar month-end with verified support work, health, supplies, movement, exposure, migration and whole-person transfers

records.label: Overview
notes: These are civilian camp and administrative support populations attached to non-state military organizations or armed communities. They are not troop manpower, do not materialize as military units, consume no military unit command slots, and incur casualties only through actual exposure of their camp, treatment site, evacuation chain, transport route, settlement, or administrative movement.

facts.education_and_career_rule: monthly process records verified medical work, sanitation, stores, apprenticeship, health, migration and whole-person transfers
facts.materialization_rule: an exact civilian medical identity deducts one real support-population slot and inherits only settled civilian support history
facts.occupational_programs: camp medical care, triage, wound stabilization, sanitation, medical stores, casualty routing and evacuation support; no line-combat drill or formation-command curriculum

facts.education_and_career_rule: monthly process records verified courier work, route familiarity, animal care when mounted, message custody, literacy where applicable, health, migration and whole-person transfers
facts.materialization_rule: an exact civilian courier identity deducts one real civilian support slot and inherits only settled civilian occupational history; courier status grants no combat qualification
facts.occupational_programs: civilian message carriage, administrative running, route travel, dispatch custody and ordinary mounted transport; no reconnaissance combat role, formation-command curriculum or line-combat drill
